raw_text:
PLAN "Prenatal Strength Maintenance"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
GOAL primary strength
name "Maintain functional strength safely through pregnancy"
END GOAL
GOAL secondary stability
name "Build core stability and pelvic floor resilience"
END GOAL
END GOALS

PHASES
PHASE "Phase 1: Weeks 1-4" (4 weeks)
WEEK 1
DAY Monday training 50m "Upper body and core"
WARMUP
arm_circles 10 reps
shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
walking 3m
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
face_pull 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
chest_stretch 30 seconds
lat_stretch 30 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower body and glutes"
WARMUP
leg_swings 10 reps each direction
hip_circles 10 reps
walking 3m
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
split_squat 3x8 each leg rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
quad_stretch 30 seconds
hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Friday training 45m "Full body and stability"
WARMUP
jog_in_place 2m
hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
walking 2m
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds

side_plank 3x20..30 seconds each side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

END DAY
END WEEK
